title: VINTAGE HONDA EM 300 PORTABLE ...

title: MODEL TRAIN LAYOUT - OO GAUGE
findings: Complete OO gauge baseboard layout with painted backscene, multi-track double oval with sidings, station with twin canopied platforms, footbridge, signal box, goods shed, water tower, tank wagons, terraced and town buildings (Metcalfe-type card kits), church, half-timbered buildings, trees and scenic work. No locos or rolling stock beyond a couple of wagons shown. Track looks like Peco or Hornby code 100.
condition: Appears well built and tidy; large size makes transport awkward; wiring/controls not shown.
reason: Well detailed finished OO layout; railway modellers pay well for ready layouts if collectable locally.

title: PAIR SAAS CAR SEATS
